answer: Sybil resistance arises because each agent’s reputation decays with an exponential temporal half-life, so influence must be earned through sustained honest service rather than a brief activity burst. In the EigenTrust matrix, a freshly spawned identity has near-zero eigenvector centrality: it cannot inherit trust, amplify a thread, cross the terrace, or forge consensus. Reciprocity-weighted transitivity further limits collusive transfer.
